finalText:
**4.2.0 notes are written to [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).**

Of 382 commits, only 27 were user-facing fix/feat — the rest were deps, refactors, tests, and CI.

- Breaking: expired tokens now return `401` instead of `403`
- Added: failed webhook deliveries retry with exponential backoff
- Fixed: 10 items — null-cursor paginator crashes, duplicate headers, doubled trailing slash, empty allowlists rejecting requests, dropped trace ids on retry, wrong latency-histogram units, vague token-parser errors, an HTTP hang on socket drop, an unclosed pool on shutdown, and request bodies leaking into logs

Several fixes (paginator, headers, allowlist, token-parser) landed repeatedly across queue/api/webhooks/db/core/billing — I merged each into one bullet rather than listing every module.

Next: check the release date I used, 2026-08-30, matches your actual cut date.
